newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma eases, depos tick up in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma eases, depos tick up in late trade.

text.p: Ecu/drachma came off intraday highs to trade around 301.95 in late dealing and depos inched higher with the central bank injecting overnight cash at an unchanged 13.40 percent to smooth out liquidity, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma has eased in late dealings trading around 301.95," said a forex trader at a foreign bank.
Money dealers said depos were inching higher in late trade and the central bank smoothed out interbank liquidity by injecting overnight money at 13.40 percent.
Bond traders said interest to buy FRNs was gradually resurfacing as players realised that it could be the last time that they could buy into them before the state levied a tax on new issues.
High-level officials at the national economy ministry who wanted to keep their anonymity insisted that there would be no retroactive taxation of FRNs.
The mark was quoted at 157.40/50 drachmas from Wednesday's 157.350 fix, the dollar at 238.06/06 drachmas from 239.180 and the Ecu at 301.83/93 from 301.950 drachmas.
